Snivy

Grass

Unova · Generation 5

Snivy is a Grass-type Grass Snake Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8.1 kg. It evolves into Servine. Its highest base stat is Speed (63), with a base stat total of 308.
